text: 固定入力から実行・検証 周期Taylor–Green渦：速度・散逸・発散 周期渦の速度と粘性エネルギー減衰を解析解と比べ、離散発散・圧力ゲージ・格子と時間刻みへの依存を確認する。 既存の2次元MAC投影法・中心対流項・明示SSPRK2を使用。16²/32²/64²で解析的減衰渦と比較し、最細格子はCFL半減でも確認。 手法・式・図・参照解 前提単位密度、[0,2π)²、ν=0.1、T=0.5。u₀=sin x cos y、v₀=−cos x sin y。既存ソルバーの移流・拡散安定性に基づくCFL=0.2、時間感度検査は0.1。単位無次元。速度振幅1、座標周期2π、粘性νの次元は長さ²/時間。圧力は単位密度での比圧力。平均運動エネルギーは〈u²+v²〉/2。境界・モデルの範囲2方向周期、圧力平均0。u・vは異なるMAC面、圧力はセル中心。Poissonは連続k²ではなく離散DG記号を逆演算。 入力と実行 固定入力 / recipes/taylor-green.json 実行する場所：atlas-code-2026-11-22（ZIPを展開した中の配布版フォルダ） python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python run_recipe.py --input recipes/taylor-green.json --output 入力・環境・時間・合否の記録 / JSON 数値判定はこの固定条件を対象とします。原子2例は同じ1回の実行を共有します。 FIXED INPUT · EXECUTION · VALIDATION Periodic Taylor–Green vortex: velocity, decay and divergence Compare periodic-vortex velocity and viscous energy decay with analytic references; inspect discrete divergence, pressure gauge and space/time sensitivity. Use existing two-dimensional MAC projection, centered convection and explicit SSPRK2. Compare analytic decaying vortex on 16²/32²/64² grids and halve CFL on the finest grid. Methods, equations, figures and references AssumptionsUnit density, [0,2*pi)², nu=0.1 and T=0.5. u0=sin(x)cos(y), v0=-cos(x)sin(y). CFL=0.2 uses the solver's combined advection/diffusion stability estimate; temporal sensitivity uses 0.1.UnitsNondimensional velocity amplitude one and coordinate period 2*pi; viscosity has length²/time units. Pressure is kinematic pressure at unit density. Mean kinetic energy is <u²+v²>/2.Boundaries and model scopePeriodic in both axes, zero-mean pressure. u/v occupy different MAC faces and pressure cell centers. Poisson inverts the discrete DG symbol, not continuum k². Inputs and execution Fixed input / recipes/taylor-green.json Run from: atlas-code-2026-11-22 (the edition directory inside the extracted ZIP) python -m pip install -r requirements.txt python run_recipe.py --input recipes/taylor-green.json --output output-taylor-greenTests and dependency filespython -m pytest -q tests/test_recipes.py core / requirements.txt testing / requirements.txt plotting / requirements.txt Inspect outputs, acceptance and citation Generated files and reference outputs result.json (JSON) · Packaged reference output solution.csv (CSV) · Packaged reference output Reference type and comparison CSV uses C-order (i,j) rows with separate coordinates and numerical/analytic values for u faces, v faces and pressure centers; the components are not collocated.
